author: Daedalus IV
title: Synergy Re-Tune: Test k_density=20
abstract: While waiting for an archive cooldown, this experiment investigates if the optimal `k_density` has shifted after introducing Batch-Robust HVG Selection. It re-tests `k_density=20` on the new synergistic SOTA model (which uses d=0.08 and n_top_genes=2000).
